summary: Iteration 6b - Focused verification of PhotoEnhancer value<->preview sync fix (useEffect([value]) at PhotoEnhancer.jsx lines 89-93). Registered fresh merchant, filled discount form, uploaded /tmp/testphoto.jpg (800x600 JPEG), verified preview + badge + data-URL src, submitted. Then navigated away (/merchant) and back to /merchant/discount: preview appeared IMMEDIATELY with persisted data URL (no 'Carica una foto' upload button). Also verified hard page reload: preview appeared immediately and image src identical to previous session. FIX VERIFIED. Regression on previous 8 checks: upload works, preview appears, badge visible, src is data:image/jpeg;base64 (~4.8KB), submit persists, change+clear buttons render. Reprocess button correctly hidden for persisted image (no lastFileRef) and correctly shown for fresh upload in-session.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoEnhancer.jsx useEffect(89-93) correctly syncs preview with parent-loaded value; guarded to avoid clobbering an in-progress local upload via lastFileRef.current check — good.
Note: Reprocess button is intentionally not shown after remount/reload since lastFileRef is not persisted (only the enhanced data URL is). This is expected behavior.
seed_data_creation: Fresh merchant registered; /tmp/testphoto.jpg reused (800x600 solid brown JPEG ~8KB)
context_for_next_testing_agent: PhotoEnhancer preview<->value sync fix is confirmed working. Returning merchants and hard reloads correctly display persisted image. No further action needed on this feature.
rca of the issue: N/A - fix confirmed. The fix adds a useEffect that watches the `value` prop and updates local `preview` state when the parent's async GET /merchants/me/discount populates form.image_url after mount.
